payload.text: (2026-10-22) **Three agent kinds, three naming schemes** (hv): sleeve agents <hostname>-<role>, project agents <project>-<suffix>, estate agents <estate>-estate (sinclair-estate, geodica-estate; the -vc suffix on those two was wrong). Estate agents are Gtools-provisioned and start in the estate's content root (GTOOLS_ESTATE), where the deployed .claude/ is; a launch above that root loads no contract, because Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md and settings from the launch dir and its parents, never a child.
